messages:
Maria G: Quick pulse — we need a clearance matrix + duty roster for the new open models (Nimbus-3B, ZephyrLite). Launch window is T-7 days. Who's owning licenses, canary, and perf gate? :eyes:
Devin: I can take canary orchestration. Will coordinate with eng-infra for capacity.
Ajay: Perf numbers from the staging run this morning: Nimbus-3B (fp16) median p50=85ms, p95=240ms on g4dn. ZephyrLite (int8) p50=40ms, p95=95ms. Need to validate memory tail behavior.
Luis (Legal): License scan: Nimbus-3B lineage OK but needs attribution notice in docs. ZephyrLite has a compatibility clause — I have a shortlist of required wording, sending PR today.
Maria G: @Devin please add canary owners to the duty roster and assign an on-call for the first 72h. @Luis (Legal) ping when the PR lands so we can attach to the catalog entry.
ingest-bot: Manifest ingestion report: 2 models queued, 0 errors. Ingest job id: job-2026-03-18-77.
Devin: Putting together the canary plan — target rollout: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100% over 48h, with automatic rollback on regression >3% on latency or >1% on token quality delta.
Ajay: Snapshot of manifest we used in staging (snippet):
```
model: Nimbus-3B
version: v1.0.0
quant: fp16
perf_profile: "balanced-low-latency"
batching: { max_tokens: 2048, max_batch: 8 }
```
Maria G: For ownership: canary = Devin, model curation + docs = Maria, integration tests = Ajay, legal = Luis. Sound right? :thumbsup:
Sam P: Add this to the launch spreadsheet (link: https://go/release-ml-catalog) and mark blockers column if legal wording isn't merged. Also we need a console dashboard card for model-level cost estimates.
Luis (Legal): PR posted: https://git.internal/legal/nimbus-attribution — tagging @Maria G for doc text. I'll accept changes once attribution section is in README.
Ajay: Quick note on perf gating — for ZephyrLite int8, add an extra regression check around tail-latency at sequence length 1024. I saw a ~15% spike at p99 in one run. Gate: must be <5% vs baseline.
Devin: I'll wire up the canary monitors and add the alert rules to the rollout job. ETA end of day.
Maria G: OK — action items: 1) Devin: canary monitors + duty roster 2) Luis: legal PR merge 3) Ajay: add tail-latency check to perf suite 4) Sam: update spreadsheet + dashboard ticket. Please drop short updates here as you finish.
Devin: Will do.
Luis (Legal): Noted, will update when merged.
Ajay: Added the tail-latency check in the perf CI, PR: https://git.internal/ml/perf/pull/482.
Maria G: Great — thanks everyone. We should be green to start canary once legal PR is merged and perf CI passes. :rocket:
